title: Validate blunder export paths before opening files
description: CodeQL flagged `scripts/analysis/blunder_eval_common.py` with `Uncontrolled data used in path expression` in the helper that opens exported game files. The current code resolves and opens whichever path the caller supplies, without validating that the file lives under an explicitly allowed export root or even matches the expected export filename/suffix conventions. This is broader file access than the analysis scripts need and leaves the security finding unresolved. Follow-up should define the allowed export roots and export filename invariants, then reject paths outside that set before opening them. The fix needs to preserve legitimate test flows that analyze temporary exported files created under pytest temp directories.
